history.titleZh: Up to 30x More Work Per Watt: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Sets a New Efficiency Standard for AI Agents
history.descriptionZh:
代理式AI（Agentic AI）正在从根本上改变人工智能工作负载的格局。据OpenRouter数据，代理式AI工作负载的token消耗量是简单聊天请求的15倍。以AI代理研究一家公司并做出投资决策为例：代理需要查询金融数据库、搜索新闻和监管文件、调用子代理进行同行比较和估值建模，最后将所有信息综合为投资建议。代理和子代理在整个任务完成之前会持续进行推理，每一步积累的token都会成为下一步的输入，这使得长上下文处理能力成为决定代理式AI性能的核心因素。同样的模式贯穿于所有代理式应用场景——软件开发、客户服务、深度研究等，无一例外。

随着代理式AI在各行业全面进入生产环境，底层基础设施必须高效满足这种急剧增长的token需求。NVIDIA最新公布的实测数据显示，在代理式工作负载下，Vera Rubin NVL72系统每兆瓦吞吐量比GB300 NVL72高出30倍。该数据基于SemiAnalysis AgentX工作负载测量，这一负载包含录制自真实世界的代理式编码会话，完整保留了实际的上下文增长过程、工具调用和子代理生成行为。对于受电力约束的AI工厂而言，这直接意味着相同能耗下可完成30倍于以往的代理式工作量。

代理式工作负载与传统聊天或文档摘要任务有着本质差异——后者的输入输出序列通常在1K到8K token之间，而代理式会话中上下文会随步骤持续累积，输入token可达到数十万量级，且各请求的输入输出长度波动极大。因此，性能评估方式也必须从单一的推理请求扩展为完整的代理工作流评估。

在SemiAnalysis AgentX测试中，NVIDIA Blackwell平台在多个主流代理模型上均展现出领先性能，包括Kimi K3、MiniMax M3、GLM5.3、Qwen3.5和DeepSeek V4 Pro等。以DeepSeek V4 Pro模型为例，GB300 NVL72的每兆瓦吞吐量较NVIDIA Hopper架构提升15倍，这得益于更大规模的GPU纵向扩展域和软硬件协同设计带来的推理效率优势。Vera Rubin NVL72则将整个Pareto性能曲线向上推移，在DeepSeek V4 Pro模型上实现了较GB300 NVL72高达30倍的每兆瓦吞吐量提升。需要说明的是，这些初步测量结果尚待SemiAnalysis审核，且未计入Vera CPU在工具调用环节的性能表现。

吞吐量效率直接决定了每个token的生产成本。Vera Rubin NVL72每百万token成本较GB300 NVL72降低高达35倍，使企业能够以规模化方式持续运行代理，覆盖全部客户工作负载类型。对于受电力制约的AI工厂而言，每兆瓦吞吐量决定了工厂收入，而每百万token成本则决定了这一收入的利润空间。

Vera Rubin NVL72通过跨平台各层面的"极端协同设计"实现了多倍性能提升，其核心技术包括：

- **分离式服务**：将上下文处理（prefill）与响应生成（decode）分离，使两者可独立扩展
- **速率匹配**：同步prefill GPU与decode GPU的token生成速度，最大化整体效率
- **大规模专家并行**：将混合专家模型中的专家子网络分布到整个GPU纵向扩展域
- **分布式KV缓存**：将内存扩展到整个纵向扩展域，并将不活跃上下文分级卸载至主机和存储，避免重复计算
- **KV感知路由**：将请求引导至已持有相关缓存上下文的GPU，减少长会话中的冗余计算
- **融合CUDA内核（MegaMoE）**：将大量计算和GPU间通信操作合并为单次执行，避免GPU因等待数据而闲置

NVIDIA Rubin GPU的第五代增强版Tensor Core和第三代Transformer Engine加速了推理的prefill和decode两个阶段。NVFP4量化将模型权重压缩至4位精度，在不牺牲输出质量的前提下减少内存占用并提升吞吐量。NVL72纵向扩展域作为Vera Rubin和Grace Blackwell的共同核心架构，为大规模专家并行和分布式KV缓存等技术提供了所需的高带宽低延迟GPU间通信——第六代NVLink互连技术和NVLink Switch的报文速率比商用以太网方案高10倍，延迟低3倍。软件层面，优化CUDA内核、TensorRT LLM推理运行时和NVIDIA Dynamo服务框架均与硬件协同设计，全面支持上述推理优化。

当前数据反映的是Vera Rubin NVL72的现有性能，而完整平台是一个七芯片架构，还包括NVIDIA Vera CPU、Groq 3 LPU、NVLink 6 Switch、BlueField-4 DPU、Spectrum-6 SPX和ConnectX-9 SuperNIC，全部为大规模部署代理的AI工厂量身打造。NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS技术还在GPU、机架和工作负载三个层面管理功耗，在相同兆瓦预算内可多配置40%的GPU，进一步推升AI工厂规模的每兆瓦吞吐量。

目前Vera Rubin已进入全面生产阶段，正在整个生态系统中扩展部署。这些初步成果展示了NVIDIA加速创新的节奏，随着软件优化持续推进，Vera Rubin NVL72和GB300 NVL72的性能都将继续提升。对于正在将代理式AI推向生产环境的企业来说，这意味着更低的token成本、更高的能源效率和更可行的规模化部署路径。

history.title: Two Intel chips break Amazon's top 10 CPUs for the first time in months — Core Ultra 7 270K and Core i7-14700K finally challenge AMD desktop dominance
history.description: AMD has dominated the DIY space so thoroughly over the last few years that an Intel chip appearing in the top 10 at all is notable, but it's not really that surprising if you look at the details.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter AMD has been the dominant force in DIY PC building CPUs for several years now, thanks to the advent of Zen 3 and great chips like the Ryzen 7 5800X3D, and more recently its potent Ryzen 7 X3D SKUs like the 9800X3D. Now, just days after AMD touted that it continues to occupy all 10 slots in the Amazon CPU best-sellers list, a couple of Intel CPUs have broken into the list for the first time in months, as spotted by WCCFTech. AMD continues to dominate, but Intel has cracked the top 10 with a couple of compelling options. (Image credit: Amazon)The two chips in question aren't surprising if you know ball. Coming in at number six is the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus for $290 USD; Intel's most recently released desktop CPU, and at nine we have the workaday Core i7-14700K for $312, a steady seller since its launch in 2023. It offers less performance in gaming than many of the other chips in the top 10 (including the cheaper 270K Plus), but it has the advantage of being able to slot into both aging LGA 1700 systems as well as new builds with DDR4 memory. That's also likely why the Ryzen 5 5500 continues to stay near the top of the chart at #2, while the Ryzen 5 5600X and Ryzen 7 5800X3D (in its 10th Anniversary guise) also rate high. As for the Core i7-14700K, we actually recommended it over the Ryzen 7 5800X3D in our review of the 10th Anniversary re-release of that chip for people who are building new DDR4 machines.The Core Ultra 7 270K Plus appearing this high is heartening for Intel's sake, though. If you haven't kept up with Intel's CPU releases, this chip is a course correction from the first-generation "Arrow Lake" processors, offering outstanding productivity performance and very solid gaming performance, just a few percentage points off of the beloved Ryzen 7 7800X3D that sits one position above it in the rankings. Put frankly, the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus beats everything else in the top 10 for both single- and multi-core performance save for the $569 Ryzen 9 9950X3D, which is in an entirely different price class from the $290 Intel chip (though discounted quite significantly at $569, 19% off the $699 list price)Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Image 1 of 15 (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) (Image credit: Tom's Hardware) Image 1 of 15 View Original Image 2 of 15 View Original Image 3 of 15 View Original Image 4 of 15 View Original Image 5 of 15 View Original Image 6 of 15 View Original Image 7 of 15 View Original Image 8 of 15 View Original Image 9 of 15 View Original Image 10 of 15 View Original Image 11 of 15 View Original Image 12 of 15 View Original Image 13 of 15 View Original Image 14 of 15 View Original Image 15 of 15 View Original It's clear that gaming continues to be a top driver for the DIY market. Five of the chips in the top 10 have been on our list of the Best CPUs for Gaming either now or at some point, including the number one seller, the Ryzen 7 9800X3D. AMD's 3D V-Cache continues to be unbeatable in gaming, even if the Arrow Lake 'Plus' parts do their best to close the gap with extremely high single-core performance. It's not single-threaded speed that's the bottleneck anymore, though, and not for some time; the limitation in gaming frames is multivariate as it has ever been, but on the CPU side, it's largely down to memory performance these days, and that's exactly why AMD's 3D V-Cache chips dominate.Of course, if you're reading Tom's Hardware, you probably don't need me to tell you that. But it's interesting to look at the pricing of the parts that are moving the most units. The Ryzen 5 5500 is a tame processor, but if you need a gaming PC for the absolute bottom dollar, it's hard to beat six Zen 3 cores with a CPU cooler for $84. The Ryzen 7 7800X3D seems an absurd choice next to the much faster Ryzen 7 9800X3D for less than $100 more, but the gaming performance is really pretty close, and you're likely to desire a drop-in Zen 6 processor upgrade late this year or early next year, so why spend the extra $85 now?That CPU upgrade angle warrants consideration. Any Socket AM5 processor has a path forward, and that's not the case for any extant Intel platform nor for Socket AM4, despite the fact that Intel is apparently releasing new LGA 1700 chips eventually. Ultimately, memory pricing is probably driving a lot of these choices, but in the upgrade context, it's not quite as surprising to see five and a half of the top ten CPUs on platforms that require DDR5 memory—the 'half' being the Core i7-14700K, naturally. (Image credit: Tom's Hardware)You absolutely can build a DDR4 machine using the Raptor Lake Refresh CPUs, but the performance penalty can be significant; in our testing, we found that it was actually worse than just running a single DDR5 DIMM. It's the PC builder's Sophie's Choice: buy a last-generation CPU to save significant cash on the RAM, or suck it up and spend out massively on a system that offers the best performance now.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors Pricing is naturally also a factor; the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus launched at the comically low price of $299 in comparison to the $589 Core Ultra 9 285K, which it performs very close to, so $290 isn't much of a discount there. Meanwhile, the Core i7-14700K's $311.99 price tag is 16% off of Amazon's list price of $370.99, but it's a bit larger markdown from Intel's $419 recommended customer price. Still, if pricing is your primary motivator, it's hard to ignore the $330 Ryzen 7 7800X3D (27% off list), at least as long as gaming is your main concern. There's the 5800X3D 10th Anniversary, too, but again, the Core i7-14700K actually offers better minimum framerates and vastly superior productivity performance, especially if you're willing to do some memory tuning.Clearly, gamers have accepted that memory pricing isn't coming back down any time soon, and that the time to buy is now before it gets even worse. The shortage isn't expected to abate between now and late 2028; if you're keen to build a new machine in the in-between, make sure you keep an eye on our Deals posts to save yourself from bleeding too much at the checkout. history.titleZh: 两款英特尔芯片数月来首次闯入亚马逊CPU畅销榜前十——酷睿Ultra 7 270K和酷睿i7-14700K终于挑战AMD的桌面霸主地位
history.descriptionZh:
AMD在DIY装机CPU市场的主导地位已经持续多年，这要归功于Zen 3架构的推出以及诸如Ryzen 7 5800X3D这样的优秀芯片，更近期的则有性能强劲的Ryzen 7 X3D系列产品，比如9800X3D。然而就在AMD宣称其继续包揽亚马逊CPU畅销榜全部10个席位仅仅几天之后，两款英特尔芯片数月来首次闯入了这份榜单的前十名。AMD依然占据统治地位，但英特尔凭借两款颇具竞争力的产品成功跻身前十。

这两款闯入榜单的芯片并不令人意外。位列第六的是售价290美元的Core Ultra 7 270K Plus，这是英特尔最近发布的桌面CPU；排名第九的则是售价312美元的Core i7-14700K，这款芯片自2023年发布以来一直是稳定的畅销款。Core i7-14700K在游戏性能上不及前十名中的许多其他芯片（包括更便宜的270K Plus），但它的优势在于既能兼容老旧的LGA 1700平台，也能用于搭配DDR4内存的新装机。这也解释了为什么Ryzen 5 5500能继续稳居第二名，而Ryzen 5 5600X和Ryzen 7 5800X3D（以十周年纪念版的形式）也排名靠前。Tom's Hardware在评测5800X3D十周年再版时，实际上就向那些组装新DDR4机器的用户推荐了Core i7-14700K，而非5800X3D。

Core Ultra 7 270K Plus能排到如此高位，对英特尔来说是个令人振奋的信号。如果你没有持续关注英特尔的CPU发布，需要了解的是，这款芯片是对第一代"Arrow Lake"处理器的纠偏之作，提供了出色的生产力性能和相当扎实的游戏性能，与排名恰好在其上方一位、备受喜爱的Ryzen 7 7800X3D相比仅落后几个百分点。坦率地说，Core Ultra 7 270K Plus在单核和多核性能上超越了前十名中的所有其他芯片，唯一例外是售价569美元的Ryzen 9 9950X3D——但后者与这款290美元的英特尔芯片完全不在同一个价位档次（尽管9950X3D的价格已从699美元的官方标价大幅折扣19%至569美元）。

显而易见，游戏依然是DIY市场的主要驱动力。前十名中有五款芯片曾登上或正在Tom's Hardware的游戏CPU最佳榜单，包括销量冠军Ryzen 7 9800X3D。AMD的3D V-Cache技术在游戏领域依然无可匹敌，即便Arrow Lake "Plus"系列凭借极高的单核性能在尽力缩小差距。然而如今瓶颈早已不再是单线程速度——游戏帧率的限制因素向来是多方面的，但在CPU层面，当前主要受制于内存性能，这正是AMD的3D V-Cache芯片能够称霸的原因所在。

当然，如果你正在阅读Tom's Hardware，大概不需要别人来告诉你这些。但观察那些走量最多的芯片定价确实很有意思。Ryzen 5 5500是一款性能平平的处理器，但如果你想以绝对最低的成本组装一台游戏PC，84美元就能买到六核Zen 3核心外加一个CPU散热器，这个性价比很难被击败。Ryzen 7 7800X3D与快得多的Ryzen 7 9800X3D只差不到100美元，看起来选后者似乎更合理，但7800X3D的游戏表现其实已经非常接近，而且你很可能在年底或明年初想要升级到Zen 6处理器，那现在何必多花那85美元呢？

CPU升级路径这个角度值得认真考量。任何Socket AM5处理器都有未来的升级空间，而英特尔现有的任何平台以及Socket AM4都不具备这一条件，尽管英特尔据称最终会发布新的LGA 1700芯片。归根结底，内存价格可能在很大程度上驱动着这些购买决策，但从升级的语境来看，前十名中有五款半芯片所在的平台需要DDR5内存，这并不太令人意外——那"半款"自然就是Core i7-14700K。

你当然可以用Raptor Lake Refresh CPU搭配DDR4内存装机，但性能损失可能相当显著。在Tom's Hardware的测试中，DDR4配置的表现实际上比单条DDR5内存还要糟糕。这简直就是PC装机者的"索菲的抉择"：买上一代CPU以省下可观的内存开销，还是咬咬牙花大价钱组装一台当前性能最佳的系统。

价格自然也扮演着重要角色。Core Ultra 7 270K Plus以299美元的惊人低价发布，相比之下589美元的Core Ultra 9 285K性能与其非常接近，因此290美元这个价格实际上并没有多大折扣。与此同时，Core i7-14700K的311.99美元售价比亚马逊370.99美元的标价便宜了16%，但相比英特尔419美元的建议零售价，折扣幅度更大。不过，如果价格是你最核心的考量因素，那么330美元（较标价折扣27%）的Ryzen 7 7800X3D很难被忽视，至少在你主要关心游戏表现的情况下是如此。此外还有5800X3D十周年纪念版可选，但如前所述，Core i7-14700K在最低帧率上表现更好，生产力性能更是远超对手，尤其如果你愿意花功夫调校内存的话。

显然，玩家们已经接受了内存价格短期内不会回落的现实，也意识到趁现在还没涨得更离谱之前入手才是明智之举。内存短缺预计到2028年底之前都不会缓解；如果你打算在此期间组装新机器，务必留意Tom's Hardware的优惠信息，以免在结账时多花冤枉钱。

history.title: Marvell VP pushes for DDR4 recycling for use in CXL memory, amid the worst DRAM shortage in years — company introduces three-tier AI memory infrastructure
history.description: Marvell has introduced a three-tier "AI memory infrastructure" portfolio, announced at FMS 2026 in Santa Clara on August 4.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Memory will account for roughly 30% of hyperscaler capex this year, up from about 8% in 2023 and 2024. Conventional DRAM contract prices rose 90% to 95% in a single quarter, and Meta is already running recycled DDR4 behind CXL across millions of servers, cutting server counts by up to 25% for some inference workloads. Into that market, Marvell has brought a three-tier "AI memory infrastructure" portfolio, announced at FMS 2026 in Santa Clara on August 4 and pitched to EE Times last week, where product marketing VP Khurram Malik put DDR4 reuse at the top of the CXL use-case list.Only one piece of it is new: the Bravera SC6 PCIe 6.0 SSD controller, which samples in Q4. Structera X has been shipping since 2024, the Structera S switch was announced at OFC in March, and the Photonic Fabric optical memory tier came with the Celestial AI acquisition in February. Meta, the reference customer for the use case Marvell is selling, did it with an ASIC of its own design rather than anything from Marvell.What's new (and what isn't)The Bravera SC6 is a PCIe 6.0 x4 controller with 16 NAND channels, eight chip enables per channel, a 3,600 MT/s ONFI and Toggle interface, and 12 Arm Cortex-R82 cores plus three Cortex-M7s, according to Marvell's product blog.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Marvell says it doubles the Bravera SC5, supports NAND from multiple suppliers, and uses a host-managed flash translation layer, meaning cloud operators control write placement, garbage collection, and wear leveling themselves, with KV cache spillover from HBM to SSD as the primary workload. Sampling starts in Q4 2026, which puts drives in 2027 at the earliest on the timeline Tom's Hardware Premium laid out for the PCIe 6.0 controller field, where Phison and Silicon Motion are chasing the same Gen6 drive launches.Structera X 2404 and X 2504, the DDR4 and DDR5 expansion controllers, were announced in July 2024, and Marvell's FMS blog says both are in hyperscaler deployments, with inline LZ4 compression that Malik told EE Times yields roughly 2 to 2.5 times the effective capacity. You may like Meta fights soaring hardware costs by reusing old DDR4 server memory in new DDR5-only servers The rise of local agentic computing faces a brutal reality: rising DRAM prices SMI's PCIe 6.0 SSD controller for consumer SSDs coming next year, but severe NAND shortages will get even worse in 2027 as AI data centers swallow supply The Structera S 30260 switch, announced at OFC in March, carries 260 PCIe 6.0 and CXL 3.x lanes, connects 16 or 32 CPUs or GPUs to up to 48TB of shared memory at 4 TB/s aggregate bandwidth and under 460ns round trip, and begins sampling this quarter. Photonic Fabric came in with the $3.25 billion Celestial AI acquisition that closed in February, with Marvell now describing it as a shared-memory tier reaching up to 50 meters with up to 32 TB of warm KV cache and a claimed 2 to 3 times token throughput inside existing footprints. Marvell also took a $2 billion investment from Nvidia in March, tied to NVLink Fusion, the proprietary scale-up fabric CXL pooling has to sit alongside.DRAM contract prices have tripled since Structera launchedConventional DRAM contract prices rose 90% to 95% quarter-on-quarter in Q1 2026, the steepest increase on record for every DRAM category. Q2 added another 58% to 63%, and server DRAM is set to climb a further 13% to 18% in Q3, held in check mainly by the long-term agreements U.S. hyperscalers signed to cap pricing through 2027 and 2028. Server DRAM buyers in the U.S. and China were receiving about 70% of their orders late last year as suppliers diverted wafers to HBM.Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron have all been winding down DDR4 output since last year, and TrendForce put the legacy memory rally at up to 50% for DDR4 in Q1 alone. A module pulled from a decommissioned 2021 server is now worth a multiple of what it was when Structera X was announced, and the DDR5 that would replace it has roughly doubled in price twice. When Marvell first pitched DDR4 reuse in 2024, it was a sustainability line item, but two years later, the memory crunch has turned it into a capex line item.Meta's recycling numbersMeta's Vistara ASIC, presented at ISCA 2026 in late June, is a CXL 2.0 Type-3 expander on a PCIe 5.0 x16 link that bridges two DDR4 channels to a host and runs at 128GB per chip using 32GB modules recovered from retired machines. Each MemServer pairs a 158-core AMD EPYC Turin with 768GB of local DDR5-6400 and 256GB of CXL-attached DDR4-2400, and Meta claims idle round-trip latency of around 50ns on the controller path.The paper states that around 40% of Meta's fleet is memory-capacity bound, that its servers last three to five years while the DRAM inside them is good for seven to 10, and that the deployment cuts server counts by up to 25% for disaggregated ML inference, average latency by 29% for distributed caching, and job failures by 33%, The Register from the paper ahead of the talk. What to read next The current state of PCIe 6.0 SSDs and controllers DRAM chip supply to memory module makers could drop by more than 70% in 2027, says Apacer CEO Researchers turn HBM on its side to tackle AI memory’s heat wall Malik told EE Times, "The first and foremost important use case within CXL is the recycling of DDR4," and Marvell's FMS release says Structera X was "developed in close collaboration with leading hyperscalers" without naming one. Meta's paper describes an in-house ASIC, an in-house MemServer chassis, and an in-house Linux page-placement stack, the full path one would take when volume justifies its own silicon, while Astera Labs' Leo controllers reached Microsoft Azure's M-series preview in November last year.CXL's deployment gapSemiAnalysis declared CXL dead for AI in March 2024 because Ethernet-style SerDes such as NVLink carry roughly three times the bandwidth per millimeter of die edge as PCIe 5.0 or 6.0, so every CXL lane on an accelerator costs scale-up bandwidth that could have gone to the GPU-to-GPU fabric instead.Marvell's CXL pitch accordingly targets CPU-side capacity and KV cache staging rather than the GPU-to-GPU path where you’ll find NVLink Fusion. Yole estimated two-thirds of servers sold in Q1 2025 were CXL-capable and expects more than 90% to be by the end of this year, yet it puts the share of servers actually using CXL at close to zero today and only 13% by 2030.Marvell's benchmarks for the Structera S show a 16TB pooled DRAM tier delivering 4.8 times the inference throughput and an 82.7% cut in time to first token in GPU configurations, attributed to keeping KV cache in DRAM instead of recomputing or reloading it. Those are vendor numbers with no disclosed model or baseline, and the switch only starts sampling this quarter. Nvidia, AMD, and the SSD makers all offer their own routes for the same cache spillover.

history.titleZh: Marvell副总裁推动DDR4回收用于CXL内存，
history.descriptionZh:
内存正成为超大规模数据中心资本支出中最大的单一变量：预计今年占比约30%，而2023和2024年仅为8%。常规DRAM合约价在一个季度内飙升90%至95%，Meta已经在大规模生产环境中通过CXL将回收的DDR4内存部署到数百万台服务器上，使部分推理工作负载的服务器数量减少多达25%。在这样的市场背景下，Marvell于8月4日在圣克拉拉举行的FMS 2026上推出了名为"AI内存基础设施"的三层产品组合。产品营销副总裁Khurram Malik向EE Times表示，DDR4内存回收利用是CXL最首要的应用场景。

## 新产品与既有产品线

这套组合中真正全新的只有一款：Bravera SC6 PCIe 6.0固态硬盘控制器，计划于2026年第四季度出样。其余部分早已存在：Structera X扩展控制器自2024年起出货；Structera S交换机在3月的OFC大会上发布；Photonic Fabric光内存层则来自2月完成的Celestial AI收购（交易金额32.5亿美元）。值得注意的是，Marvell作为参考客户宣传的Meta案例，实际上是Meta用自研ASIC完成的，并未使用Marvell的任何产品。

Bravera SC6是一款PCIe 6.0 x4控制器，集成16个NAND通道、每通道8个片选（chip enable）、3,600 MT/s ONFI与Toggle接口，并配备12个Arm Cortex-R82核心外加3个Cortex-M7核心。根据Marvell官方博客，其性能是前代Bravera SC5的两倍，支持多家NAND供应商，并采用主机管理闪存转换层（host-managed FTL），这意味着云运营商可以自行控制写入位置、垃圾回收和磨损均衡。该控制器的主要工作负载是将KV缓存从HBM溢出到SSD。样品将在2026年第四季度开始提供，这意味着实际驱动器产品最早要到2027年才能上市，与Phison、Silicon Motion等竞争对手的Gen6产品时间线基本一致。

Structera X 2404和X 2504分别是DDR4和DDR5扩展控制器，已在超大规模数据中心部署。其内置的内联LZ4压缩技术据Malik称可将有效容量提升约2到2.5倍。

Structera S 30260交换机早前在OFC发布，提供260条PCIe 6.0/CXL 3.x通道，可将16或32个CPU/GPU连接到最多48TB共享内存，聚合带宽达到4 TB/s，往返延迟低于460纳秒，本季度开始出样。

Photonic Fabric随收购而来，被描述为一种共享内存层，延伸到50米，可提供最多32TB的"热"KV缓存，并声称在相同物理空间内可将token吞吐量提升2到3倍。此外，Nvidia在3月向Marvell投资20亿美元，关联到NVLink Fusion——CXL内存池化必须与之并行的专有scale-up互联。

## DRAM价格疯涨：DDR4回收从可持续性变成资本支出

自Structera X推出以来，DRAM合约价已经翻了三倍。2026年第一季度常规DRAM合约价环比上涨90%至95%，创下所有DRAM品类有记录以来最大单季涨幅；第二季度再涨58%至63%；第三季度服务器DRAM预计还要上涨13%至18%——这个涨幅之所以相对温和，主要因为美国超大规模厂商签署了到2027年、2028年的长期协议来限制价格。去年年底，由于供应商将晶圆产能转向HBM，美国和中国市场的服务器DRAM买家只能收到约70%的订单。

三星、SK海力士和美光自去年起逐步减产DDR4。TrendForce数据显示，仅第一季度传统DDR4价格就上涨最多50%。如今，从一台2021年退役服务器中拆下的内存模块，其价值已比Structera X发布时高了好几倍；而作为替代品的DDR5内存价格也大概翻了两番。Marvell在2024年首次推广DDR4回收时，它还是"可持续发展"叙事的一部分；两年后，内存短缺已经把它变成了实实在在的资本支出削减工具。

## Meta的回收实践：Vistara ASIC与MemServer

Meta在6月底的ISCA 2026上展示了其自研方案Vistara ASIC。这是一款基于PCIe 5.0 x16链路的CXL 2.0 Type-3扩展器，桥接两个DDR4通道到主机，每颗芯片最高支持128GB，使用的是从退役机器上回收的32GB内存模组。每个MemServer节点搭配一颗158核AMD EPYC Turin处理器、768GB本地DDR5-6400内存，以及256GB通过CXL挂载的DDR4-2400内存；控制器路径上的空闲往返延迟约为50纳秒。

据The Register提前报道的论文内容，Meta约有40%的服务器集群受内存容量限制；服务器寿命通常为三到五年，而其中的DRAM可以稳定运行七到十年。通过该部署，非聚合式ML推理的服务器数量最多减少25%，分布式缓存的平均延迟降低29%，作业失败率下降33%。Malik对EE Times强调："CXL中最重要的应用场景就是DDR4回收。"Marvell的FMS新闻稿也表示Structera X是"与领先超大规模厂商密切合作开发"的，但未具名。Meta的论文描述了完全自研的ASIC、自研MemServer机箱和自研Linux页面放置栈——这是当需求量足以支撑自研芯片时才会走的完整路径。与此同时，Astera Labs的Leo控制器已于去年11月进入Microsoft Azure M系列预览。

## CXL部署的现实困境

SemiAnalysis曾在2024年3月宣称CXL对AI而言已死，理由是NVLink等以太网式SerDes每毫米芯片边缘的带宽大约是PCIe 5.0或6.0的三倍，因此在加速器上每一条CXL通道都会挤占本可用于GPU间互联的scale-up带宽。Marvell的CXL叙事因此刻意瞄准CPU侧容量扩展和KV缓存暂存，而非NVLink Fusion所在的GPU到GPU路径。

Yole的数据显示，2025年第一季度售出的服务器中约三分之二支持CXL，预计到今年年底这一比例将超过90%；但实际使用CXL的服务器比例目前几乎为零，到2030年也只有13%。Marvell为Structera S提供的基准测试表明，16TB池化DRAM层可带来4.8倍的推理吞吐量提升，并将首次token生成时间缩短82.7%——因为KV缓存保存在DRAM中，无需重新计算或从存储重载。不过，这些是厂商单方面提供的数据，未披露模型或基线，且交换机本季度才开始出样。Nvidia、AMD及各SSD厂商也都有各自的缓存溢出解决方案。

Marvell的三层产品线——SSD控制器、CXL扩展器/交换机和光内存——实际上是在为同一个核心问题提供不同带宽/延迟层级的答案：在DRAM价格失控的时代，如何让AI工作负载在有限内存预算下运行得更快。DDR4回收通过CXL复用老内存，无疑是最具现实吸引力的一步；但它在多大程度上能形成规模，仍取决于超大规模厂商是否愿意追随Meta的路径，以及CXL生态能否真正跨越从"支持"到"使用"的鸿沟。
